name: Cơm lam
summary: Rice cooked in a bamboo tube, eaten toward Langbiang or in Cu Lan village with sesame salt.
origin: Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note names cơm lam on the Langbiang side of Da Lat and in Cu Lan village.
howToEat: The note says eat the tube with sesame salt, grilled forest meat, grilled chicken, and grilled eggs.
It attributes the sweetness to upstream water and the smell to young bamboo. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Toward Langbiang, or in Cu Lan village. A stall number is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.
